cards.name: Ajani, Nacatl Pariah // Ajani, Nacatl Avenger

Ragost, Deft Gastronaut.text: In the list. Every artifact is a Food; `{1}`, sac a Food: 3 to each opponent, untaps when we gained life — the Food → damage engine (R2).

Iroh, Tea Master.text: Donate a permanent each combat for a growing Ally; donating a spent Food is cheap. Spicy, slow.

Samwise Gamgee.text: In the list. Food per nontoken creature entering; three Foods → historic card back.

Sam, Loyal Attendant.text: In the list. Food every combat and every Food ability costs `{1}` less: halves the crack cost (R2).

Lita, Little Orphan Amphibian.text: In the list (2026-11-06). Alliance Food / counter / scry per creature entering.

Krovod Haunch.text: A Food card (Courier tutors it), +2/+0 equip, two Dogs when it dies.

Hobbit's Sting.text: In the list. Instant removal, X = creatures + Foods — real interaction at `{1}{W}` (R6).

The Battle of Bywater.text: Kills power 3+ — ours too, once Rocco's counters land.

Food Coma.text: In the list. O-ring a creature plus a Food — interaction (R6).

Bill the Pony.text: Two Foods; the toughness-damage trick is narrow.

Bumi's Feast Lecture.text: In the list (2026-11-06). Food, then earthbend twice the Foods — a large hasty land by mid-game.

Lucky the Pizza Dog.text: In the list. Cat / Dog / Hero spell → Food; lifegain → counter. Value tracks the Cat+Dog count (R5).

Meriadoc Brandybuck.text: Halflings attack → Food; depends on the Halfling count.

Michelangelo, the Heart.text: In the list (2026-11-06). Attack → counter + Food each turn.

Pawpatch Formation.text: In the list. Modal instant: flier or enchantment removal, or draw + Food (R6).

Hinterland Chef.text: Alchemy draft; the drafted card becomes a Food.

Peregrin Took.text: In the list. Every token creation adds a Food, and three Foods: draw a card — card advantage from the currency (R2).

Stew the Coneys.text: In the list. Instant bite removal + Food (R6).

Tireless Provisioner.text: In the list. Landfall Food or Treasure; Rocco's exiled lands count (R1).

Bristlebud Farmer.text: Two Foods; attack: sac a Food to dig three for a permanent.

Elanor Gardner.text: In the list (2026-11-06). A basic each end step we sacrificed a Food is repeatable ramp, and each land is landfall for Tireless Provisioner and Felidar Retreat.

Provisions Merchant.text: Food; attack: sac a Food for team +1/+1 and trample.

Wicked Wolf.text: In the list. ETB fight (interaction) and a Food sink for counters + indestructible.

Big Spender.text: Alchemy; Treasure on blocks, spellbook for two artifacts.

Improvised Arsenal.text: +1/+0 per artifact — Foods make it large — and {4}{R} copies it; equip {R}.

Urabrask's Forge.text: A token every combat — each is an extra Food under Peregrin / Tippy-Toe and a counter under Rosie.

Svella, Ice Shaper.text: Mana rock maker; the `{8}` free cast is slow.

Pia Nalaar, Consul of Revival.text: In the list. Every play from exile is a hasty 1/1 flier — a second Rocco payoff (R1), and each token is a Food under Peregrin / Tippy-Toe.

Mabel, Heir to Cragflame.text: Mouse lord; the equipment is the value here.

T'Challa, the Black Panther.text: Vibranium tokens; counters on big artifact spells.

Toph, the First Metalbender.text: Earthbend 2 each end step; artifacts-as-lands is incidental.

Mondrak, Glory Dominus.text: In the list. Doubles every token: Foods, Thopters, Cats.

Indomitable Creativity.text: `{R}{R}{R}` polymorph; destroys our own Foods for random permanents.
